title: Still Here
description: "still here?" in a tall navy serif saves itself as a JPEG over and over on its own, each copy made from the last, until blocks, ringing and purple colour bleed take the line apart; then it rewinds clean and starts again. Pause it, drag through the generations, or type your own line and watch it wear.
intent: Generation loss that runs by itself: every step is a real canvas.toBlob JPEG decoded back with a slight wobble, cached per generation so the line can be scrubbed, rewound and replayed while the file size ticks down.
sources: herb reference board: 51b6830b "still here?" condensed navy serif with JPEG artefacts
